meaning:
1) price, value, preciousness, honour, splendour, pomp
1a) preciousness
1b) price
1c) honour, esteem
Aramaic equivalent: ye.qar (יְקָר "honor" H3367)

elsewhere.note: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.
He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into…
There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They…
Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter, the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver, and threw them to the potter…
